post.description:
Create an account with email + password; returns our JWT pair and emails
a verification link (the account starts unverified).

Confirm an email from the link we mailed. Redirects back to the cabinet
with ?verified=1 on success, ?verified=0 for a stale or bad link.

post.description:
Re-send the verification email to the signed-in user. Idempotent: does
nothing if the address is already confirmed.

Email a password-reset link. Always 202 — the response never reveals
whether the address belongs to an account.

schema.title: Response Forgot Password Api Auth Forgot Password Post

post.description: Set a new password from a reset link. 400 for a stale or invalid link.

End this session by retiring its refresh token.

End every session of the signed-in user — the button you want after a
device is lost.

The languages I'm learning (distinct word languages) with word counts —
what the practice/dictionary language switcher is built from.

delete.description: Remove a word from MY dictionary (the shared entry stays for others).

get.description: Which exercise types the pool generates for me (all of them by default).

put.description: Choose which exercise types to practise; disabled ones leave the pool.

get.description: My daily AI-generation quota (unlimited for active subscribers).

post.description:
Generate exercises on demand.

The pool normally refills after a word is captured; this lets a user who
has answered everything ask for more without saving a new word. Pass
`exercise_type` to get that specific kind. Generation is CPU-bound, so the
request can take a while.

get.description:
Progress of a queued refill, so the UI can poll instead of waiting.

Scoped to the task's owner: another user can't read this task's status
(404 as if it didn't exist, rather than confirming it belongs to someone).

Serve the next pre-generated exercise from MY pool (404 if empty).

Pass `exercise_type` to practise one specific type, `language` to practise a
specific language (defaults to your current one).

post.description: Answer an exercise; grades it and feeds the result into spaced repetition.

get.description: All users, newest first; `query` matches email or name.

patch.description: Change a user's role, status or profile fields.

delete.description: Delete a user and all their data (cascade).

post.description: Add a word to a user's personal vocabulary.

delete.description: Remove a word from a user's vocabulary (leaves the shared dictionary).

get.description: Browse the SHARED dictionary; filter by `language` and lemma prefix `query`.

patch.description: Edit the SHARED dictionary entry — affects every user who has this word.

delete.description: Delete an exercise from a user's pool.

post.description:
Bulk-import a general dictionary (word→translation table) into the shared
words. Runs in the background (Celery, or in-process).

`normalize` sends messy raw_text through the LLM to extract clean pairs;
otherwise the pairs are split deterministically here.

get.description: Progress of a queued dictionary import, so the admin panel can poll it.

delete.description: Cancel a running import: terminate the task so it can't be redelivered.
